scope: All 14 views shown in the project README, captured twice with actual native NR disabled/enabled

pythonTests.environment: NR_DEPS_DIR and NR_BUILD_DIR point to the prepared SDK/toolchain cache; scripts/linux/common.sh sourced
pythonTests.initialUnconfiguredRun: Two compiler-backed tests (environment switch and material archive) could not find clang++; passed when run with the configured build toolchain.

regression.before: Wall-clock animation produced different Fox scene inputs at the same numbered frame (8-bit diagnostic preview MAE 0.6798181905864197).
regression.after: Scripted capture advances by 1/60 second per rendered frame; all14 off/on linear HDR inputs are byte-identical, including Fox Run and Dish glass-cover animation.

comparisonRules.displayTransform: Both ordinary outputs use webgiDisplay (ACES fit + sRGB). The Reinhard -scene.ppm debugging previews are not published as NR-off.
comparisonRules.inputEquality: Full linear HDR RGB raw data and dimensions byte-identical for each pair
comparisonRules.cameraEquality: Recorded projection and view text identical at default C++ stream precision
comparisonRules.animation: Successful rendered-frame step 1/60 s; frame40; identical clip and time on both sides
comparisonRules.presentation: Native960x720 pixels on each side; gutters and labels outside pixel areas only; no resizing, retouching, color adjustment or enhancement
comparisonRules.qualityClaim: Images show the current implementation. Pixel differences verify effect, without claiming numerical parity or universal quality improvement.

galleries.pathPolicy: artifact paths relative to repositoryRoot; source, result and generator paths relative to this layout file
galleries.pixelBboxConvention: [left, top, right, bottom], zero-based, right and bottom exclusive

policy.source: display capture *-nr-static.ppm only; scene preview PPMs excluded
policy.pixelTransform: none; RGB byte-for-byte paste into lossless RGB PNG
policy.labelsAndFooter: drawn outside all source pane bounding boxes
